propositions: Failed LLM calls invoke interpret_failure() which re-raises, causing control to exit run() before record() is called, leaving no usage row written for calls that may consume substantial tokens
Usage log omission causes spend totals computed by summarize() to silently under-report actual spend by exactly the failed calls, impacting weekly CI job summaries
Per-step attribution added by change b690 cannot see failed calls, making failure-to-exhaustion retries (the expensive cases operators want to attribute) invisible in usage analysis

record_failure() must be called from run()'s except block before interpret_failure() to ensure failed calls write rows with identifying fields (op, step, model_class, model, provider) plus known token counters and an explicit outcome marker
A failed call that is retried must not double-count: the failed attempt writes outcome=failed and the retry writes outcome=ok, so exactly one row attributes to delivered work
